Signing mechanism: HMAC-SHA256 following the Standard Webhooks convention — the payload is signed using `hmac.New(sha256.New, key)` over `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + body`, with the signature sent as a `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>` header alongside `webhook-id` and `webhook-timestamp` headers. Signing secrets use the `whsec_<base64>` format (Standard Webhooks spec).
